name: ons-segment
description:
[en]
  Segment component. Use this component to have a button bar with automatic styles that switch on click of another button.
  Will automatically display as a Material Design segment on Android.
[/en]
[ja][/ja]

guides.name: theming.html#modifiers
guides.description: [en]More details about the `modifier` attribute[/en][ja]modifier属性の使い方[/ja]

guides.name: theming.html#cross-platform-styling-autostyling
guides.description: [en]Information about cross platform styling[/en][ja]Information about cross platform styling[/ja]

attributes.name: tabbar-id
attributes.description:
[en]ID of the tabbar element to "connect" to the segment. Must be inside the same page.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: active-index
attributes.description:
[en]Index of the first active button, only works if there is no connected tabbar (in which case the active tab sets the active button).[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description:
[en]Specify if segment should be disabled.[/en]
[ja]ボタンを無効化する場合は指定します。[/ja]

attributes.name: var
attributes.description:
[en]Variable name to refer this segment.[/en]
[ja]このタブバーを参照するための名前を指定します。[/ja]

attributes.name: ons-postchange
attributes.description:
[en]Allows you to specify custom behavior when the "postchange" event is fired.[/en]
[ja]"postchange"イベントが発火された時の挙動を独自に指定できます。[/ja]

events.name: postchange
events.description:
[en]Fires after the active button is changed.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

properties.name: disabled
properties.description:
[en]Whether the segment is disabled or not.[/en]
[ja]無効化されている場合に`true`。[/ja]

methods.name: setActiveButton

params.name: options
params.description:
[en]Parameter object, works only if there is a connected tabbar. Supports the same options as `ons-tabbar`'s `setActiveTab` method.[/en]
   [ja][/ja]

returns.description:
[en]Resolves to the selected index or to the new page element if there is a connected tabbar.[/en]
   [ja][/ja]

methods.description:
[en]Make button with the specified index active. If there is a connected tabbar it shows the corresponding tab page. In this case animations and their options can be specified by the second parameter.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

methods.name: getActiveButtonIndex

returns.description:
[en]The index of the currently active button.[/en]
   [ja][/ja]

methods.description:
[en]Returns button index of current active button. If active button is not found, returns -1.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

elements.name: ons-segment
elements.description:
[en]Angular directive for `<ons-segment>` component.[/en]
[ja]`<ons-segment>`要素のAngularディレクティブです。[/ja]

inputs.name: activeIndex
inputs.description:
[en]Input index of the active button.[/en]
[ja]アクティブなボタンのインデックスを設定します。[/ja]

inputs.name: tabbar
inputs.description:
[en]The tabbar component to "connect" to the segment. Must be inside the same page. Works only during initialization.[/en]
[ja]このセグメントに紐づけるタブバーを指定します。タブバーはセグメントと同一ページ内に存在する必要があります。初期化時にのみ動作します。[/ja]

outputs.name: postchange
outputs.description:
[en]Triggers when the index of the active button is changed.[/en]
[ja]`ons-segment`要素のアクティブなボタンのインデックスが変わった時に呼び出されます。[/ja]

outputs.name: activeIndexChange
outputs.description:
[en]Triggers when the index of the active button is changed.[/en]
[ja]アクティブなボタンのインデックスが変化した時に発火します。[/ja]
